neighbours.label: the word right after a day-part noun (night before, morning after, night sky): before, after or sky, with the same words quiet after other lead-ins
fire: They flew in the night before the funeral.
I felt awful the morning after the party.
Astronomers mapped the night sky above Chile.
The bank was closed, but the day after it reopened.
We packed the evening before our trip.
Tourists watched the evening sky turn red.
He phoned the afternoon before the exam.
She quit the day before Christmas.
quiet: They flew in shortly before the funeral.
I felt awful soon after the party.
Astronomers mapped the southern sky above Chile.
The bank was closed, but long after that it reopened.
We packed well before our trip.
Tourists watched the grey sky turn red.
He phoned right before the exam.

notes: A shared pattern behind the card's before, after and sky: they peak when they follow night, day, morning or evening. Probing: 'an hour before' and 'blue sky' were low. Exception not explained: 'Tokyo Institute' fires strongly, so coverage is probably partial.
